title: Signed circulants at the Ramanujan bound
summary: For the circulant graph $C_n(1,2)$ with $n\ge10$ even, the $\F_2$ system requiring every quadrilateral to be unbalanced is consistent and its solutions form exactly four switching classes. We show that the class containing the signing which is $+1$ on step-$1$ edges and $(-1)^i$ on step-$2$ edges has spectrum $\{\pm2\sqrt{\cos^2θ_k+\cos^2 2θ_k}\}$ and spectral radius exactly $2\sqrt2$, well below the Kesten bound $2\sqrt3$; that the quadrilateral system is equivalent to alternating triangle fluxes, so that the four classes are coordinatized by $(τ_0,α)$ and the spectral radius depends only…
